user.title: Connect E.ON Next
user.description: Paste an E.ON Next API key, or a refresh token from a logged-in eonnext.com session. See the integration's README for how to get either.

data_description.token: An API key starts with `sk_live_`. Anything else is treated as a refresh token from a logged-in eonnext.com session.
data_description.create_api_key: Only applies to a refresh token. A refresh token stops working after about a week; an API key doesn't. The integration only creates a key if your account has none, and asks first if it already has one.

reauth_confirm.title: E.ON Next login expired
reauth_confirm.description: The saved login no longer works. Paste your API key, or log in to eonnext.com again and paste a new refresh token.

api_key_exists.title: Your account already has an API key
api_key_exists.description:
Your E.ON Next account already has an API key (`{masked}`). Another app or integration may be using it, or it may be from an earlier setup.

Each account has only one key. Creating a new one makes the existing key stop working everywhere.

menu_options.enter_api_key: I have the existing key - enter it
menu_options.replace_api_key: Replace it with a new key
menu_options.keep_refresh_token: Keep using the refresh token for now

replace_api_key.title: Replace the API key?
replace_api_key.description:
This creates a new API key and cancels the existing one. Anything else using the old key (another integration, an app, another Home Assistant install) will stop working until you give it the new key.

Your E.ON Next website and app logins are not affected.

api_key_created.title: API key created - save it now
api_key_created.description:
Your new E.ON Next API key is:

`{api_key}`

It has been saved in Home Assistant. **Copy it to your password manager now** - E.ON won't show it again, and you'll need it to set this integration up on another Home Assistant install. Treat it like a password: it gives full access to your E.ON Next account.

Submit to finish.

error.invalid_auth: E.ON Next rejected it. A refresh token may have expired or already been used; an API key may have been replaced.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach E.ON Next. Check the logs for details.
error.no_prepay_meters: No smart meters in prepayment mode were found on this account.
error.not_an_api_key: That doesn't look like an API key - they start with `sk_live_`.

abort.already_configured: This E.ON Next account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: That login belongs to a different E.ON Next account.

switch_to_api_key.title: Switch E.ON Next to an API key

confirm.title: Switch to an API key?
confirm.description:
This integration is logged in with a refresh token, which E.ON Next ends about a week after you copied it from the browser. You then have to paste a new one.

An API key doesn't expire. Submitting creates one for your E.ON Next account using the current login - nothing to paste. If your account already has a key, you'll be asked what to do before anything changes.
